analysis: Active SF/MF residual comparison on the same archived feature-switch probes

scope.covariance: Left-cycle body-frame log-Cholesky coordinates held fixed within each probe pair
scope.geometry: Archived CPU float32; original benchmark CUDA float32

units_and_formulas.R: sum of per-feature Gaussian violation probabilities; sum itself need not generally be <=1
units_and_formulas.jump: right minus left; aggregate statistics use absolute values
units_and_formulas.mf_branch_1: inverse_cdf, without lower-tail clipping or linear extension

limitations: These are offline, selected switch-boundary probes from two successful CC-SF trials at prediction stage10, not independent trials or observed continuous-time transitions.
Geometry is archived CPU float32 while the original benchmark used CUDA float32; near-tie selectors can differ. Quantile and covariance arithmetic uses float64.
Bisection brackets are below float32 geometric resolution; tiny MF deltas are numerical finite differences, not a proof of mathematical continuity or a universal reduction factor.

All probes are in the active MF domain and use no slack/solver, isolating residual evaluation from gating and slack. This does not establish the causal contribution of aggregation to driving success or safe-stop reduction.

Same quantile units support a probability-residual sensitivity comparison. This is not an assertion that the deployed SF distance QP row and MF quantile QP row have identical numerical scaling or linearizations.
Raw internal selector changes can reflect endpoint aliases/ties. Gradient thresholds are diagnostics and are not a proof of identical correspondences.
A small MF change does not imply MF chance feasibility; some MF residuals are negative on both sides.
Multiple boundaries can come from one adjacent-cycle pair; the33 records are not statistically independent.
reproduction_recipe: For each existing boundary CSV row, find nominal states by cycle_before/cycle_after. Reconstruct left/right poses using alpha +/- 0.5/(32*2**18); copy all nonpose coordinates, especially covariance, from cycle_before.

Use archived wrapper on both float32 poses, convert gradients to local frame using local_q and the same float64 heading. Compute sigma from the retained log-Cholesky covariance and the chosen PSDF gradient. Verify gamma*sigma equals the deployed clipped risk (no clipping was active).
Compute SF quantile residual, and wrapper.forward_mf_icdf(float64 state,epsilon,d_min,return_frozen_features=True). No stage override, row relaxation, optimizer or solver is used.
Compare raw idx_v/idx_e from _capture_forward and per-feature q/mask from frozen_features. Native SF margin delta must match the existing CSV within1e-7mm.
Aggregate absolute jumps using numpy median and percentile(...,95). Source hashes below identify every input and helper.
